elements.name: Payment Element
elements.summary: Collect payment details for many methods in one Element. Prefer this over Card Elements for new integrations.
elements.notes: Wrap in ngx-stripe-elements. Set clientSecret on the parent Elements options before create — nested Elements cannot update clientSecret later. Use @if until the secret exists. doNotCreateUntilClientSecretIsSet defers implicit (non-parent) create.

extraInputs.name: doNotCreateUntilClientSecretIsSet
extraInputs.description: When true, skip creating the Payment Element until a clientSecret is available (implicit Elements path).

elements.name: Express Checkout Element
elements.summary: Wallet buttons (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, PayPal, …) in one Element. Replacement path for Payment Request Button on endive.
elements.notes: Parent ngx-stripe-elements with a PaymentIntent/SetupIntent clientSecret, or deferred mode + amount (see Express Checkout docs). Bind (clicked) not (click). Confirm via stripe.confirmPayment with the same Elements instance. Checkout Sessions ui_mode=elements use initCheckoutElementsSdk instead.

elements.name: Link Authentication Element
elements.summary: Collect email and authenticate returning Link customers on checkout.
elements.notes: Place inside the same ngx-stripe-elements as Payment Element. Email is collected by the Element — do not also pass it on confirmPayment unless you have a reason to. Stripe now documents this flow as Contact Details (`ngx-stripe-contact-details`); this host remains for the linkAuthentication type.

elements.name: Link Signup Element
elements.summary: Collect Link signup details (email / name / phone defaults) next to Payment Element.
elements.notes: Requires Link enabled on the Stripe account. Use the same Elements group as Payment Element. Types from @stripe/stripe-js (≥ 9.16).

elements.name: Address Element
elements.summary: Collect shipping or billing addresses. Autocomplete when used with Payment Element.
elements.notes: Create with options.mode 'shipping' or 'billing'. Call getValue() to validate and read the address.

elements.name: Contact Details Element
elements.summary: Collect customer contact details (email) inside Elements.
elements.notes: Dahlia+ (ngx-stripe 21.9 / 22.9). Stripe’s current name for the Link email Element (was Link Authentication). Listen to (change) for complete / value. Prefer this over ngx-stripe-link-authentication for new work.

elements.name: Tax Id Element
elements.summary: Collect a customer's tax ID inside Checkout/Elements.
elements.notes: Dahlia+. Call getValue() after mount. Enable Tax ID collection in Stripe Dashboard / Checkout settings as required by Stripe.

elements.name: Terms Element
elements.summary: Show Stripe-hosted terms/agreements in the payment form.
elements.notes: Dahlia+. Options are Stripe-owned (often empty). Pair with Payment Element in the same ngx-stripe-elements.

elements.name: Currency Selector Element
elements.summary: Let the customer pick a presentment currency when Stripe Adaptive Pricing / currency selection is enabled.
elements.notes: Dahlia+. Requires a PaymentIntent/SetupIntent whose currency settings allow selection. Stripe owns the option object (currently empty).

elements.name: Payment Method Messaging
elements.summary: Show buy-now-pay-later / installment messaging (Klarna, Affirm, Afterpay, …) for a given amount.
elements.notes: Does not collect payment details. amount is in the smallest currency unit. Enable the payment methods on the Stripe account.

elements.name: Card Element
elements.summary: Single iframe for card number, expiry, and CVC. Prefer Payment Element for new work.
elements.notes: Split fields use ngx-stripe-card-number, ngx-stripe-card-expiry, ngx-stripe-card-cvc inside ngx-stripe-card-group.

elements.name: Card Number Element
elements.summary: Split Card Element — number field. Use with ngx-stripe-card-group.
elements.notes: Must sit with expiry and CVC in the same card group.

elements.name: Card Expiry Element
elements.summary: Split Card Element — expiry field.
elements.notes: Use with ngx-stripe-card-group.

elements.name: Card CVC Element
elements.summary: Split Card Element — CVC field.
elements.notes: Use with ngx-stripe-card-group.

elements.name: IBAN Element
elements.summary: Collect a SEPA IBAN. Often used with createToken / confirmSepaDebitPayment.
elements.notes: Pass supportedCountries. Confirm with the matching Stripe.js method (e.g. confirmSepaDebitPayment) or createToken for the legacy token flow.

elements.name: AU Bank Account Element
elements.summary: Collect Australian BECS Debit account details.
elements.notes: Enable au_becs_debit on the Stripe account. Confirm with confirmAuBecsDebitPayment / Setup. BSB + account number are Stripe-hosted.

elements.name: Issuing Card Number
elements.summary: PCI-compliant display of an Issuing card number. Requires an Issuing nonce from your backend.
elements.notes: Not a checkout Element. Pass issuingCard and nonce in options. See Issuing docs page.

elements.name: Issuing Card CVC
elements.summary: PCI-compliant display of an Issuing card CVC.
elements.notes: Requires Issuing nonce.

elements.name: Issuing Card Expiry
elements.summary: PCI-compliant display of an Issuing card expiry.
elements.notes: Requires Issuing nonce.

elements.name: Issuing Card PIN
elements.summary: PCI-compliant display of an Issuing card PIN.
elements.notes: Requires Issuing nonce.

elements.name: Issuing Card Copy Button
elements.summary: Copy button paired with Issuing display Elements.
elements.notes: Dahlia+. to: must reference the Issuing display Element to copy from.
